messages:
alex: Quick green-sweep ask — target cutoff for v1.12.0 is in 6h (PATCH cutoff 2026-03-17 18:00 UTC). Can folks kick off CI smoke and report failures? CI dashboard: https://ci.redwood.ai/pipelines/7423
maria: On it, starting local smoke run + triggering pipeline. Will post fails.
ci-bot: pipeline #7423 triggered by maria — job id 7423.12. URL: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/7423.12
pranav: FYI i saw a flaky in integration/embeddings.test lately, i'll watch that one.
lee: Re-running failing integration shard: run `./scripts/ci_retry.sh integration embeddings` — requeueing now.
jess: got a red — two failing tests in runtime: latency-estimator.test and grpc-proxy.test. logs: ```ERROR: Timeout waiting for response (seq 42)
grpc_proxy.go:193: deadline exceeded
```
alex: thx jess, can you paste the failing test names into the flaky-triage doc? link: https://docs.redwood.ai/flaky-triage
maria: smoke pipeline is green for unit + lint, but integration matrix has 1 fail (grpc-proxy.test) on p3-node; re-run in progress.
ci-bot: rerun triggered by lee — rerun id 7423.13
pranav: rerun passed on that shard. I think that's the embeddings flake i mentioned earlier — marking as flaky and adding skip if necessary.
jess: rerun passed for grpc-proxy, leaving a comment on the PR: `// infra: flaky on CI - disable until fix` @alex?
alex: please don't modify tests in PR at cutoff unless it's an explicit flaky-mark. We'll do a canary rollback if needed. For changelog, reminder: bump version in package.json + mention runtime fixes. @sam-release please vet.
maria: @sam-release pinged.
sam-release: I can do final changelog merge in ~2h, keep me posted.
lee: FYI infra noticed a queue backlog around 16:40 UTC — clearing backlog reduced latency. No impact to green-sweep now.
alex: summary: unit/lint green, integration had transient flakes but reruns passed. Ok to proceed to cutoff unless new fails pop. Please add any remaining fails to flaky-triage doc and tag me.
maria: ack :thumbsup: 
ci-bot: pipeline #7423 closed — status: success.
